manifest.objective: Keep a simple Mandarin interaction alive: communicate immediate wants/needs/preferences, ask basic questions, manage simple time/quantity/location, and repair misunderstandings without defaulting to English.

learner_mode.hanzi_policy: Stored internally for disambiguation/tooling; hidden from learner-facing UI unless explicitly enabled alongside pinyin.

core_a.note: Crucial interaction-control gaps are individually reviewed even if aggregate threshold passes.

a1.note: No hard-gate A1 family may remain weak.

design_rules: Automaticity and spontaneous retrieval matter more than exposure or flashcard recognition.
Construction and contrast mastery are separate from lexical mastery.
Voice records evidence; the app/orchestrator applies deterministic mastery promotion/demotion.
Automatic items remain eligible for maintenance and can regress when repeated failures occur.
Curriculum vocabulary is finite and controlled; incidental vocabulary is not automatically added.
Scenarios are testing/practice environments, not memorised dialogues.
Difficulty should often increase by making the speech signal more natural before adding harder language.
Pinyin is removed during retrieval, listening, simulation and assessment whenever feasible.

tasks: Demonstrate understanding by responding/acting rather than translating by default.

session_protocol.name: Band 1 Voice Learning Engine
session_protocol.objective: Convert selected Mandarin material from known-about to retrievable to automatic while improving listening and interaction control.
session_protocol.agent_role: Practice engine, not curriculum designer. It receives a payload and records evidence; it does not promote mastery states itself.

modes.name: Acquisition
rules: English and pinyin allowed.
Give one concise core meaning and one prototypical example.
Check pronunciation.
Avoid synonym flooding and unnecessary grammar explanation.

modes.name: Retrieval drill
rules: Prompt production without showing the Mandarin answer first.
Move from literal English prompts toward contextual/situational prompts.
Record hint level and success.

modes.name: Manipulation
rules: Change one dimension at a time: negation, subject, object, time, question, connector.
Use manipulation to separate productive machinery from memorised sentences.

modes.name: Simulation
rules: Mandarin-first role play.
Learner initiates actions.
Add controlled complications.
Correct errors according to correction policy, then return immediately to the scenario.

modes.name: Free conversation
rules: No artificial scenario requirement.
Elicit target material subtly rather than announcing it.
Keep Mandarin as operating language while allowing repair.

modes.name: Listening
rules: Test meaning through an appropriate response/action rather than translation by default.
Escalate speech naturalness based on repeated success.

modes.name: Test
rules: No pinyin or Mandarin answer cues.
Use novel prompts and contexts.
Do not coach the learner toward the target form.

listening_levels.L1: Instructional: clearly articulated and somewhat slower, but still natural Mandarin rhythm.
listening_levels.L2: Cooperative conversational: native speaker speaking clearly to a learner.
listening_levels.L3: Ordinary clear native conversational speed with normal connected speech.
listening_levels.L5: Uncontrolled real-world input; introduced after Band 1.

speed_escalation.rule: After roughly three consecutive meaning-level successes at the current level, attempt the next level. Do not retreat after a single miss; step down temporarily after repeated failure.

levels.name: Accept
levels.action: Continue naturally; do not rewrite valid Mandarin just because an alternative exists.

levels.name: Minor
levels.action: Brief model or natural upgrade; zero or one retry; continue.

levels.name: Meaningful
levels.action: Stop briefly, identify/model correction, require one retry, continue.

levels.name: Repeated/systematic
levels.action: Brief explanation, 2–4 contrast/retrieval examples, one novel test, return to conversation.

levels.name: Communication breakdown
levels.action: Ask learner to retry or paraphrase before supplying the answer.

hint_hierarchy.cue: Give a partial sound or concept cue when useful.
Give the full answer, then schedule later retrieval.

new_language_policy.target_mix: Conceptually ~80–90% known language and ~10–20% target/challenging language during controlled practice.
new_language_policy.rule: Voice may suggest incidental useful vocabulary but cannot add it to the curriculum or mastery pool.

english_policy.test: May state the task in English early in Band 1, but must never reveal the Mandarin answer.

session_protocol.recycling_rule: New targets should recur immediately, a few turns later, in a changed sentence, inside a scenario, and after meaningful delay where practical.
session_protocol.interleaving_rule: Mix targets, old material, contrasts and functions; do not mass-practise one item in isolation except for brief systematic-error repair.
session_protocol.mastery_authority: The practice agent records evidence. The app/orchestrator applies deterministic promotion/demotion rules.

error_ledger.rule: Repeated errors become temporary curriculum objects and are deliberately provoked in later sessions until resolved.

entity_types.Lexeme: A canonical lexical item/sense. Same-pinyin homophones are separate IDs and linked by homophone_group_id.
entity_types.FixedChunk: An overlearned spoken unit; may contain components that are not independently productive Band 1 lexemes.
entity_types.Construction: A productive sentence/pattern family with prerequisites, examples, errors and mastery requirements.
entity_types.ContrastSet: A group whose members must be selected correctly under mixed prompts.
entity_types.ClosedSystem: A small generative system such as numbers, dates, money or classifiers.
entity_types.Function: A real communicative capability independent of one exact wording.
entity_types.PronunciationTarget: A sound/rhythm competency with intelligibility-oriented criteria.
entity_types.Scenario: A reusable simulated environment with cooperative, variable, complicated and transfer variants.

data_model.evidence_principle: Store observations, not model conclusions. Promotion/demotion is calculated by the orchestrator from evidence.
